phase: ## Phase S8: Default look for new editions
summary: FAIL at 05473af0: 1 Blocker, 1 Major, 2 Nits. The default rule works for the 5 shipped Primary projects and for a new edition. The rule also reaches the tracked Reading Advantage project secondary/origins-3.1-a1, which has no look key. A probe of the real file returns chibi-quest where the phase base returned classic. The explicit look classic is the only guard of a shipped edition, and two dashboard writers delete it. Input validation of the look value holds. A request cannot choose a look or leave primary/ and secondary/. The importers in tutor-advantage and the monorepo ignore the new key. A2 is not applicable and A6 holds.
blocking_findings: F1 [Blocker] review-b: projectLook (dashboard/lib/look.ts:51) gives chibi-quest to the tracked Reading Advantage project secondary/origins-3.1-a1, which has type secondary and no look key. The phase base gave classic. The compile route (dashboard/app/api/projects/[projectId]/compile/route.ts:176) and the render route (dashboard/app/api/render/route.ts:25) now build this project in the Chibi Quest look. No test reads this file. Rationale: spec.md:159 lists Reading Advantage books as out of scope, and S8 allows no look change in a shipped title. A probe of the real project.json returned chibi-quest. Fix: return classic when meta.type is secondary. Add a failing-first test that reads secondary/origins-3.1-a1/project.json.
nonblocking_findings: F2 [Major] review-b: the explicit look classic is the only guard of a shipped edition, and two dashboard writers delete it. Workbook Settings Save sends four keys (dashboard/components/project-settings-dialog.tsx:75-80), and writeProjectMetadata overwrites the whole file (dashboard/lib/filesystem.ts:229). Create project has no existence check (dashboard/lib/filesystem.ts:268-283). The dialog offers Origins 2, 3.1, 3.2, and Quest 4 (dashboard/lib/constants.ts:46-48 and :50). Their ids equal the shipped folder names. A simulated Save on each of the 5 shipped projects gave chibi-quest. Rationale: before S8 the book table gave classic when the key was absent, so no code needed the key. Fix: keep the old look when a write has none. Refuse an existing id in createProject. Check look with parseLook in the PUT route. Add failing-first round-trip tests.

F3 [Nit] review-b: two comments still describe the old default. dashboard/lib/filesystem.ts:13 says look falls back to the book's look, and dashboard/app/api/projects/[projectId]/compile/route.ts:175 says 'or else the book's look'. Rationale: projectLook now gives chibi-quest when look is absent, so a later reader predicts the wrong look. Fix: update both comments.

F4 [Nit] review-b: a project.json that holds a truthy bare JSON value (a string, a number other than 0, true, or an array) now gives chibi-quest at dashboard/lib/look.ts:50-51, and the phase base gave classic. readProjectMetadata (dashboard/lib/filesystem.ts:214) returns the parse result with no shape check. Rationale: a damaged file failed safe to classic before S8. Fix: return classic from projectLook when meta is not an object.
evidence: HEAD current: git rev-parse HEAD returns 05473af09ed8072d4e6829bd70165daa902d4e5b at role start and after the test run. It equals audited_head_sha and role_base_sha. The brief sets phase_base_sha to 7a8e602c.

Scope: the 5 S8 commits (ad9fd95c, 85bdb148, f72cf0cf, 36905b0d, 05473af0) touch 8 non-measure paths. These are dashboard/lib/look.ts, dashboard/__tests__/default-look-new-editions.test.ts, dashboard/__tests__/workbook-look.test.ts, and the 5 primary/*/project.json files. The rest of 7a8e602c..05473af0 is the deps_refresh track, which has its own reviews and stays outside this audit.

security_applicability is applicable and narrow (measure/tracks/primary_v2_look_20261020/test-strategy.md:590). The change adds no input and no route. It changes the value that a missing key produces.

Look value validation: a node probe of dashboard/lib/look.ts (lines 26-31 and 49-54) shows projectLook gives classic for a null meta and for look null, and chibi-quest for an absent key. It throws unknown look for '', 'Classic', 'CHIBI-QUEST', 'classic ', 0, 1, false, true, [], ['classic'], {}, 'constructor', '__proto__', and 'toString'. parseLook uses Array.includes on a closed list, so no object-key lookup exists.

Prototype keys: JSON.parse of a project.json with a __proto__ key and with a constructor.prototype key gives an own property only. projectLook returns the default for both, and ({}).look stays undefined, so no global pollution follows.

Null look: a project.json with look null gives classic. Green records this rule in measure/runs/primary_v2_look_20261020/green-s8-f699571a.log (handoff), and it fails safe to the shipped look. No finding.

Error handling: both routes catch the throw of an unknown look and return a generic 500 (dashboard/app/api/projects/[projectId]/compile/route.ts:214-219 and dashboard/app/api/render/route.ts:36-41). The look text and the series name reach the server log only.

Request surface: the compile route reads boolean query flags and the project id (compile/route.ts:15-27). The render route reads lesson and projectId from the body (render/route.ts:8). Neither route reads a look value, so a request cannot choose or inject a look.

Path containment: readProjectMetadata and resolveProjectPath apply assertSafePath to the resolved path (dashboard/lib/filesystem.ts:51-60, :77-98, and :200-220). A project id cannot leave primary/ or secondary/ whatever the decode steps are. I did not rely on the Next.js decode behavior, and I wrote no Next.js code.
No project: render without a project gives classic (dashboard/lib/template-renderer.ts:147). Compile with a folder but no project.json gives classic (dashboard/lib/look.ts:50).

Real data, 5 shipped: projectLook on the real project.json files returns classic for primary/origins-2-a0, adventures-1.0-a1, origins-3.1-a0, origins-3.2-a0, and quest-4-a1. Each file now has the look key, and the 5 diffs add only that key.

Real data, F1: projectLook on secondary/origins-3.1-a1/project.json (type secondary, no look key) returns chibi-quest. The base source (git show 7a8e602c:dashboard/lib/look.ts, lines 49-54) gives classic through bookLook('origins-3.1'), and bookLook is unchanged.

F1 reach: the page /projects/origins-3.1-a1/compile returned 200 in an earlier browser review (measure/runs/deps_refresh_20261121/ux-browser-d3-bc5623ee.log:146), so the project is a live route. The page calls the compile API (dashboard/app/projects/[projectId]/compile/page.tsx:48). No S8 track file names the secondary folder: a grep for secondary in spec.md, plan.md, and test-strategy.md returns no line.

F2 simulation: a project.json that holds only seriesName, levelNumber, cefrLevel, and type, as the Settings dialog sends, gives chibi-quest for each of the 5 shipped projects. The button sits on every project page (dashboard/app/projects/[projectId]/page.tsx:103).

F2 create collision: the generated ids of the offered options are origins-2-a0, origins-3.1-a0, origins-3.2-a0, and quest-4-a1, and all four folders exist in primary/. dashboard/components/create-project-dialog.tsx has no existence check (grep for exist, duplicate, and already returns no line). createProject then overwrites project.json.

F2 guard: WORKBOOKS_READ_ONLY is unset in the shell and has no line in dashboard/.env.local, so the write routes work here. The test 'marks each shipped project.json with an explicit classic look' fails at the next run after a lost key. The loss is detectable but not prevented.

Importers: tutor-advantage/packages/database/import-primary-workbooks.ts:71-74 casts the parse result and reads type, seriesName, levelNumber, and cefrLevel only. reading-advantage-monorepo/apps/workbooks/scripts/dry-run-import.ts:57-79 picks the same four string keys. A look key breaks neither importer. A grep finds no project.json reader in primary-advantage, mastery-advantage, or advantage-pr.

Cross-repo note, not a finding: reading-advantage-monorepo/docs/primary-book-editions.md:28 cites Workbooks/primary/origins-2-a0/project.json:1-6. The file now has 7 lines, and line 5 still holds the cited type primary.

Print path: PRINT_BOOKS lists the 5 shipped books (dashboard/lib/print/book-lessons.ts:13-19). Their bookLessons look is classic, and the test 'prints the books of levels 1–4 in the classic look' (dashboard/__tests__/workbook-look.test.ts:95-99) passed. The diff of look.ts leaves bookLook and CHIBI_QUEST_BOOKS unchanged.

Secrets and Thai: a scan of the S8 code diffs finds no password, token, key, database URL, or home path. The S8 test diffs hold 0 Thai characters. dashboard/__tests__/workbook-look.test.ts holds 6 older Thai characters outside the diff. I read no lesson file.
A2: no S8 file flips a draft to a published status, and S8 has no publish gate. A2 is not applicable (test-strategy.md:604).
A6: measure/tracks.md:18 keeps the track active as [~] and makes no resolved security claim. The only change of that file in the range is a deps_refresh archive entry.

Test gate: heavy-run -c 'set -o pipefail; cd dashboard && CI=true npx vitest run __tests__/default-look-new-editions.test.ts __tests__/workbook-look.test.ts' exits 0 with 2 files and 18 tests passed (second run: heavy-run exit=0). git status --porcelain content prints nothing after the run. The suite passes while F1 and F2 stand, so no test covers them.
